title: Cream Cheese Dip
blurb: Four layers stacked in a dish and warmed just enough to soften — the hot honey is what keeps this from tasting like a plain cheese board.

ingredients.qtyText: a layer, enough to cover the bottom of the dish
ingredients.note: spreadable cheese, or goat cheese left unbaked

steps: In an oven-safe dish, layer the spreadable cheese on the bottom, then the fig jam, then a drizzle of hot honey, then the chopped pistachios.
Heat in the oven for 5 minutes at 400°F, until soft. Toast the sliced baguette alongside for 5 minutes at 400°F.
Serve the warm dip with the toasted baguette for dipping.
